title: Template Selection Decision
description: Structured template selection output. Maps workload classification to a canonical Nosana pipeline template.

template_matched.description: Whether a canonical template was found. If false, custom generation is required.

match_confidence.description: Confidence that the selected template is correct for this workload (0.0 to 1.0)

customizations.description: Fields that must be modified from the base template

source_template_path.description: Relative path to the template directory within this skill
